title: Restore Verification Spec Compiler
description: Compiles the restore verification specification. Enforces: RTO is a quantitative value, integrity checks are defined, drill schedule is set, checksum method is declared, and a no-todos quality check.

error_codes.RVS001: restore-verification-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: rto_hours, drill_schedule, integrity_checks[], checksum_method
error_codes.RVS002: RTO value is not quantitative — rto_hours must be a positive numeric value, not a string like 'fast' or 'acceptable'
error_codes.RVS003: No integrity checks defined — restore verification must include specific table-level or schema-level integrity check steps
error_codes.RVS004: Restore drill schedule not defined — drills must be scheduled at a declared cadence (monthly/quarterly/etc.)
error_codes.RVS005: Checksum method not declared — specify the verification method: pg_dump checksum, file hash, or row-count comparison
error_codes.RVS006: TODO/FIXME/HACK comment found in restore verification spec files
